title: Kya yatimi isi ko kehte hai
body:
The sakina ke bayn aye baba
Kya yateemi isi ko kehte hai
Kya tamacho ka naam hai pursa
Kya yateemi isi ko kehte hai
The sakina ke bayn aye baba
Kya yateemi isi ko kehte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Wo tamache la'ee ne maare hai
Goshware bhi yu utare hai..(2)
Khoon kaano ki lou se beh nikla
Kya yateemi isi ko kehte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ek ek pal hame satata hai
Jisko dekho wohi rulata hai..(2)
Haath sar par koi nahi rakhta
Kya yateemi isi ko kehte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ashk aankho'n mein dab dabate hi
Aapka naam lab pe aate hi..(2)
Taziyana hawa mein lehraya
Kya yateemi isi ko kehte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Aap jab se bichad gaye hum se
Aankh jalti hai sozishe ghum se..(2)
Aur rone koi nahi deta
Kya yateemi isi ko kehte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Gaal nile hai pusht zakhmi hai
Zindagi har qadam sisakti hai..(2)
Ye sitam kamsini mein dekh liya
Kya yateemi isi ko kehte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Kab milega sukoon kya jaane
Kab ho jaana watan khuda jaane..(2)
Piche piche hai maut ka saaya
Kya yateemi isi ko kehte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ab to pani ki justuju bhi nahi
Koi jeene ki aarzu bhi nahi..(2)
Koi itna magar bata deta
Kya yateemi isi ko kehte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Jab bhi jaana dayar e karbobala
Haal mera sunake baad e sabaa..(2)
Mere baba se puch lena zara
Kya yateemi isi ko kehte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Aye fasil ek ghum zada kamsin
Mar gayi qaid e shaam mein lekin..(2)
Marte marte labo'n pe tha nauha
Kya yateemi isi ko kehte hai
